property_summary: After initialize with _nft = address(this), call availableForFlashLoan(address(this), 0) on a token owned by the pool: reference C's nft is address(this) so ownerOf succeeds returning true; buggy C's nft is address(0) causing ownerOf to revert, returning false.
change_summary: Set nft to address(0) instead of _nft in initialize.
